description: $0.01 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one prompt-injection scan of one submitted text: the signed verdict, every matched pattern with its position, and a sanitized copy with the flagged spans neutralized, under the published rulebook. Submitted text is never stored; the paid retry re-sends the text. A safe verdict means no published pattern matched — it is not a guarantee that a text is safe.

text.description: The text to scan (up to 8,000 characters).

name: injection_scan
